title: I Can't Breathe
summary: Patient runs out of her inhalers.  Worsening SOB for 2 weeks.  Must use Nebs, supplemental O2, solu-medrol and monitor airway.  Observe for distress.  If not done timely, patient will require increasing O2 and need mechanical airway.

history.hpi: 32 YO female with H/O uncontrolled asthma has been out of her inhalers for the past 2 months.  Works in a dusty environment and smokes 1ppd.  Now with 2 weeks history of worsening SOB, cough and difficulty speaking.
